Author bio: 
Text: BIP110 taketh away OP_IF, but giveth OP_PLENTY.

Introducing a novel way to encode arbitrary data in *contiguous* bytes. Up to 2MB fully BIP110 compliant.

OP_PLENTY encodes each 4 bit nibble of the raw data into a tapscript opcode. Decoding is trivial: take the opcode mod 22.
